messages:
Sofia Martinez: Hey y'all  started today as a product data engineer. laptop arrived but I can't open the VPN tunnel, keeps timing out. Also where's the quickstart for data infra?
Ben Cho: welcome Sofia! :tada: Quickstart is at https://internal.redwood/data-quickstart. For VPN, what OS? I can help add you to the policy.
Sofia Martinez: macOS 13.2. I click connect and it says 'authentication failed'.
People Ops (Rae): Welcome Sofia  sent the welcome kit tracking to your personal email. Badge access is in progress. I've also kicked off IT to re-enroll your device if needed.
onboard-bot: MDM enrollment success for sofia.martinez; profile: applied.
Ben Cho: if MDM applied then try deleting and re-adding the VPN profile: System Preferences > Network > VPN > - then import the profile from https://internal.redwood/vpn/profile. LMK the command output if it errors.
Sofia Martinez: will try. also, stickers preference: retro logo or neon circuit? I'm team neon. Fun fact: I once did a 10k run on stilts. Two truths & a lie: I speak 3 languages, I ran a 10k on stilts, I used to be a pastry chef.
